newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Socialists winning 286 seats -SOFRES update.
newsitem.headline: French Socialists winning 286 seats -SOFRES update.

text.p: An update of SOFRES projections in France's parliamentary election runoff vote, which was broadcast on TV at 1943 GMT, showed the Socialist party and allies winning 286 seats, the Greens nine seats and the Communist Party 36.
289 seats are required for an absolute majority.
The update showed the UDF on the centre-right with 111 seats, the RPR and right allies with 124 and the extreme-right National Front with one seat.
The Socialist party has electoral pacts with the Greens and with the Communists.
